paite: Huan TOUPA'N Elijah pingpei a van a apitouh ding in, hichi ahong hi a, Gilgal a pan Elisha toh Elijah apawt uhi.
heading: Van A Elijah Laktouhna
english: When Yahweh was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

paite: Elijah in Elisha kiang ah, "Hiai ah ana om dih; TOUPA'N Bethel a pai ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Elisha in, “TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. K'on nuse kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchi in Bethel ah apaisukkhawm uhi.
english: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

paite: Bethel a om zawlneite tapate Elisha kiang ah ahoh ua, akiang ah, "Tuni in TOUPA'N na heutupa ahon lakmangsak ding chih na thei hia?” achi uh. Ama'n, "Hi, thei mah ing, dai un," achi hi.
english: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that Yahweh will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

paite: Elijah in akiang ah, "Elisha, hiai ah na om dih; TOUPA'N Jeriko a hoh ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. K'on nuse kei hial ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Jeriko ah ahohkhawmta uhi.
english: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.

paite: Jeriko a om zawlneite tapate'n Elisha ava naih ua, akiang ah, tuni in TOUPA'N na heutupa ahon lakmangsak ding chih na thei hia? achi uh. Ama'n adawng a, "Hi, thei mah ing, dai un,” achi hi.
english: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that Yahweh will take away your master from over you today?” He answered, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

paite: Elijah in akiang ah, "Hiai ah na om dih, TOUPA'N Jordan a hoh ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, k'on nuse kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchi in anih un apaikhawmta uh.
english: Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.

paite: Zawlneite' tapate lak a mi sawmnga ava hoh ua, amaute zawn, gamla kuamtak ah ava dingh ua; amau gel bel Jordan gei ah ana dingh uhi.
english: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.

paite: Elijah in apuan la in alomzial a, tui asat a, alang tuak ah ahong kikhenta a, huchi in anih un lei keu ah apaita uhi.
english: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.

paite: Agalkah nung un hichi ahong hi a, Elijah in Elisha kiang ah, "Na kiang a pan lakmang a ka om ma in bang ahia ka hon hihsak ding hon ngen in," achi hi. Elisha in, "Na kha tan nih tang leng,” achi hi.
english: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”

paite: Ama'n, "Thil haksapi ngen na hi ve; haksa mahleh na kiang a pan lakmang a ka om lai na muhleh na tang ding, na hon muh keileh bel na tang kei ding,” achi hi.
english: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it will not be so.”

paite: Apai kawmkawm ua, ahoulim lai un hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, mei kangtalai leh mei sakolte ahong kimu guih uhi. Akal ua kigolh in akikhensakta a; Elijah bel pingpei in van ah apaitouta hi.
english: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

paite: Elisha in huai amu a, "Ka pa aw, ka pa aw, Israelte kangtalai leh asakol a tuangte aw!" chi in akikou hi. Huchi in Elijah amuta kei a; ama puan aman a, phel nih in abotkek hi.
english: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.

paite: Elijah puan hong kia leng atawm a, apaikik nawn a, Jordan lui gei ah adingh hi.
english: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.

paite: Elijah puan hong kia ala a, huai in tui asat a, "TOUPA, Elijah Pathian koi ah?" achi hi. Huchi a tui asattak in alang tuak ah hong kikhen a, Elisha agalkahta hi.
english: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is Yahweh, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.

paite: Jeriko a zawlneite tapate, amah zawn a omte'n amuh un, "Elijah kha Elisha tung ah atu mah ve," achi uhi. Amah mu ding in akuan ua, ama ah lei si in akunsuk uhi.
english: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

paite: Amaute'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhate'n mi ngalhat pipi sawmnga ka ompih uh. Na heutupa zong ding in sawl ve. TOUPA Kha in latou ahi dia, koi lai tang ah hiam, koi lai phaizang ah hiam a khia khattou ahi mai ding," achi uh. Ama'n, "Kuansak ke'n," achi hi.
english: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps Yahweh’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”

paite: Zumhuai khop a anget nung un, "Kuansak ve ua,” achi khong hi. Huchi in mi sawmnga asawl ua; ni thum sung azong ua, himahleh amuzou kei uh.
english: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn’t find him.

paite: Jeriko a anituan lai in akiang ah ahong nawn ua; ama'n akiang uah, na kiang uah, "Kuansak kei un, ka hon chi ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go’?”

paite: Huai khua a mite'n Elisha kiang ah, "En in, hiai khomun anuam mahmah a, ka toupa un leng na hon muhpih hi. Himahleh tui ahoih kei a, agam mahmah gahsuah thei lou gam ahi," achi uhi.
heading: Elisha Thillamdang Hihte
english: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”

paite: Ama'n, "Tuithawl thak hon la unla, chi thun un,” achi a; huchi in ahon la uhi.
english: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.

paite: Tuikhuk ah ava hoh a, chi athehlut a, “TOUPA'N hichi in achi, hiai tui ka limsakta, tuban siah sihna leh gahsuahlouhna a-om nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “Yahweh says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”

paite: Huchi in Elisha gen bang in tuni tan in huai tui alimta hi.
english: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.

paite: Huai a pan Bethel ah ahohtou a; lampi a apai lai in khua a pan pasal naupang hon ahong pawtkhia ua, ahong nuihsan ua, akiang ah, "Nang lugiaupa, va hohtou in, nang lugiaupa va hohtou in," achi uhi.
english: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”

paite: Anunglam anga a, amau amu a, TOUPA min in ahamsiatta hi. Huchi in gamnuai a pan vompinu nih ahong pawtkhia ua, alak ua naupang sawmli-le-nih abalgawp uhi.
english: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in Yahweh’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.

paite: Huai a pan Karmel tang ah ahoh a, huai a pan Samaria ah apai nawnta hi.
english: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.
